messages:
Maya: Heads-up: Sales briefed about a customer wanting a 120-day version retention (not just pin) for a fine-grained translate model family. They want SLA language and a deterministic migration window. Can product/legal offer standard wording?
Jon: 120d is long. Options: paid-reservation, SLA uplift on Hosted with penalties, or require Dedicated. We should avoid hard promises on model internals (quantization/optimizer changes).
Priya: Customers care about both latency and output parity. We need bench pass criteria: embedding similarity > 0.96, no more than 1.5% BLEU regression on a curated prompt set, and throughput not degraded by > 10%.
Ravi: Ops / infra note: retention = capacity reservation spike risk. If multiple customers request this, multi-tenant fragmentation could kill efficiency. Recommend a Reserved-Pool add-on.
Maya: From GTM: they'd sign if we include migration window (14 days notice + 3-day rollback window) and a renewal clause. They also asked for an audit log for model swaps.
contract-bot: Suggested clause (short): "Provider will not change the pinned model version for the Contracted Term except for security or compliance reasons. Provider reserves the right to propose a migration with at least 14 business days' notice and a documented regression test; Customer may request rollback within a 3-day window."
Priya: We should add a metric-based migration veto: if customer test-suite fails >2% on critical prompts, rollback must be allowed.
Jon: Agree. Also require customers to run canaries on their traffic. Offer: 1) Standard soft-retention (30d) included. 2) Retention Plus (120d) as a paid add-on on Hosted with a Reserved-Pool tag. 3) Dedicated retention with SLA credits.
Maya: Launch gating checklist proposal:
- Bench suite defined (perf + quality + stability)
- Infra cost delta + capacity plan approved
- Legal template for retention addendum approved
- Telemetry + regressions alerts live (team can_fallback tag)
- Two customer canaries OR one enterprise + one internal canary
Priya: Bench details I propose:
- Perf: p95 latency measured at 512 tokens <= 400ms on reserved pool
- Quality: round-trip / consistency tests >= 0.94 similarity (cosine) and BLEU delta < 1.5%
- Stability: no more than 0.5% rate of anomalous logits spikes across 10k samples
Ravi: Action owners:
- Eng (Ravi + infra) -> capacity model & canary infra (due in 5 business days)
- Product (Maya + Priya) -> bench spec + comms doc (EOW)
- Legal (Jon) -> retention addendum draft (3 business days)
Maya: Pricing idea: monthly surcharge + minimum commitment. If we need quick stopgap, we can offer a temporary Surge Reserve for 30-60d while formal contract is processed.
Priya: Also add auto-renew opt-in and a customer-initiated unpin request flow (with acceptance criteria).
contract-bot: Example JSON snippet for an opt-in retention request:
```
retention_request: {
  model: "translate-fast-v3",
  retention_days: 120,
  traffic_pct: 100,
  canary_required: true
}
```
Maya: OK let's not finalize language in thread. I'll run a 15-minute sync after Legal drops the draft. Marking this as action: legal + infra first.
Jon: I'll post the first draft into the contracts tracker when ready.
Ravi: I'll put a quick cost sketch in the infra sheet and flag if capacity > 2x normal.
Priya: Uploading sample prompt set to /mnt/onboard/retention-tests in 1hr.
Maya: Thanks all — meet in 3 days for bench spec review.
